timeline.tweet: Disney’s Peter and the Wolf. My grandmother would play the music from Peter and the Wolf for me and one day decided to show me the animated feature - I was 6. This guy still gives me the chills, even hearing the music is enough to give me goosebumps.

Friends, could you please keep me in your prayers? There is much uncertainty in the upcoming months and I am feeling crushed by my anxiety. By his grace it has been a long time since I last felt this way. I know my God is greater than this but I am struggling in this moment.

Going into my third day with aural fullness and tinnitus, days like today make me realize how I have taken the days without these symptoms for granted. Trying to make it through but it’s a struggle. The Lord is my strength in these moments of frailty.

Today marks one full week of persistent tinnitus and bi-lateral aural fullness. Starting the process of seeking out medical help, please keep me in your prayers as I travel down this path of uncertainty. Grateful for doctors and the possible treatments for this condition.

“Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God”. -Philippians 4:6 I turn to this verse when my anxiety gets out of control. thankfully my God is always in control.

Working Remotely: Day 4 I have the attention span of a small child - I am easily distracted and struggle to remain focused on my work load for more than 30 minutes. I start feeling guilty that I have the ability to work from home and am squandering it. How do y’all do it?

It looks like next week will be spent working on site on a special assignment. It will be my first time back in nearly three months and I am a bit anxious. Praying for peace and protection during this time. God is good all the time, all the time God is good.
